messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "type 1 diabetes"
set: ["type 1 diabetes", "patients with type 1 diabetes", "people with type 1 diabetes", "type 2 diabetes", "adults and pediatric patients with type 1 diabetes", "pediatric patients younger than 6 years with type 1 diabetes", "people with type 2 diabetes", "adults with type 2 diabetes", "pediatric patients with type 2 diabetes", "certain patients with type 2 diabetes", "type 2 diabetes at high risk", "use short-acting insulin before meals as directed by doctor when treating type 1 diabetes", "blood glucose in patients with type 2 diabetes", "patients with type 2 diabetes and cardiovascular disease", "diabetes", "tell your doctor if you have type 2 diabetes"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
